programme.title: Caretaker Krause - order must be / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein
programme.desc: In the comedy series "Caretaker Krause", everything revolves around Dieter Krause (played by Tom Gerhardt), who would like to turn things to his advantage, but steps in all kinds of fat and in the "Kalker Weg 5" residential complex in Koln-Kalk has to take care of order. Unfortunately, he and some tenants have a completely different idea of ​​what that should mean. There is also some turbulence for the family man. This time Dieter wants to celebrate his dachshund anniversary and invite his friends to a festival home. Surprised and geruhrt, wife Lisbeth follows the preparations for the celebration - in the erroneous belief that Dieter had thought of her wedding day! On this festive occasion, she even throws herself into her wedding dress. With her appearance she naturally causes general confusion and spoils her husband the long -handed election as a dachshund club praiser ... / In der Comedy-Serie "Hausmeister Krause" dreht sich alles um Dieter Krause (gespielt von Tom Gerhardt), der die Dinge am liebsten zu seinem Vorteil drehen mochte, dabei aber in allerlei Fettnapfchen tritt und in der Wohnanlage "Kalker Weg 5" in Koln-Kalk alle Hande voll zu tun hat fur Ordnung zu sorgen. Leider haben er und einige Mieter eine ganz andere Vorstellung davon, was das bedeuten soll. Auch familiar gibt es einige Turbulenzen fur den Familienvater. Diesmal will Dieter sein Dackeljubilaum groSS feiern und seine Freunde zu einem Fest nach Hause einladen. Überrascht und geruhrt verfolgt Ehefrau Lisbeth die Vorbereitungen zur Feier - in dem irrigen Glauben, Dieter hatte an ihren Hochzeitstag gedacht! Zu diesem festlichen Anlass wirft sie sich sogar noch einmal in ihr Hochzeitskleid. Mit ihrem Auftritt sorgt sie naturlich fur allgemeine Verwirrung und verdirbt ihrem Mann die von langer Hand geplante Wahl zum Dackelclubprasidenten ...

programme.title: Caretaker Krause - order must be / Hausmeister Krause - Ordnung muss sein
programme.desc: In the comedy series "Caretaker Krause", everything revolves around Dieter Krause (played by Tom Gerhardt), who would like to turn things to his advantage, but steps in all kinds of fat and in the residential complex "Kalker Weg 5" in Koln-Kalk is fully concerned: Again, neighbor Makielski has parked his car wrong! However, if he knew that Makielski was the new representative of the ownership assembly and thus Krauses of immediate supervisor, he had certainly written the letter a little friendlier. Hausmeister Krause reagiert auf den Affront mit einem bosen Drohschreiben. Mit allen Tricks versucht Krause, das gefahrliche Schreiben wieder in seinen Besitz zu bringen ...

Die ungleichen Partner machten sich auf die Suche nach unterirdischen Einlagerungen im Wert von angeblich 28 Milliarden Dollar - in der Nahe des einstigen SS-Truppenubungsplatzes Beneschau bei Štechovice. Laut Dokumentenfund gingen die Schatzsucher von Dutzenden Behaltern mit Kunstgegenstanden, Gold, Juwelen und Akten zu geheimen Rustungsvorhaben aus. Als zuverlassige Quelle galten Angaben von Emil Klein, des ehemaligen Kommandanten einer Pionierschule am Truppenubungsplatz Beneschau. Der SS-Oberfuhrer war dort verantwortlich fur zahlreiche Einlagerungen in unterirdische Depots kurz vor Kriegsende.Und auch das berichten die Quellen aus dem tschechischen Militar- und Staatssicherheitsarchiv: Als Kulisse fur die "Operation" diente ein angebliches Filmprojekt zu einem militarischen Manover. Mithilfe von Spezialtruppen vor Ort wurden - getarnt durch die aufwendig inszenierten Dreharbeiten - diverse MaSSnahmen ergriffen, den Schatz zu suchen und zu finden. Der Plan war, die Beute danach gemaSS vertraglicher Vorabsprachen zu teilen und zu verwerten. Das ganze Unternehmen erforderte einen enormen planerischen und logistischen Aufwand, der bis ins Detail dokumentiert ist. Doch dann fielen Schusse und Sprengsatze explodierten am Filmset.Dies war aber noch nicht das Ende der Jagd nach dem Nazischatz, deren Enthullung auf Recherchen des Prager Journalisten Jaroslav Mares und des Historikers Adam Kretschmer zuruckgeht.

In a desperate act, he takes the policewoman hostage and threatens to put an end to his and her life. / Verkehrskontrolle. Alexa und Hans mussen Geschwindigkeitsubertretungen messen. Sven Wiebel rast mit 31 Stundenkilometern mehr als erlaubt an der uberkorrekten Alexa vorbei.Er redet sich um Kopf und Kragen, damit er nicht seiner Existenz beraubt wird. Doch hat er nicht damit gerechnet, dass ihm dadurch neben dem Entzug seines Fuhrerscheins eine Anklage wegen Beamtenbeleidigung bevorsteht. Denn Alexa hat kein Mitgefuhl.Sie sieht in ihm einen Wiederholungstater. In einer Verzweiflungstat nimmt er die Polizistin als Geisel und droht, seinem und ihrem Leben ein Ende zu setzen.

programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: In a field near a country road, Stine and Timmermann find an accidental taxi. The driver, Alexandra Preuss, is still at the wheel - with a gunshot wound in the heart! The traces at the scene prove that the tider must have sitting in the car. But there is no trace of a passenger. Does Alexandra's husband Thomas have something to do with her death? Alexandra had only separated from him for a short time, but he didn't want to admit it. Alexandra Preuss was freshly in love. The new man in her life was firefighter Florian Sagmeister. The two got to know each other in a car accident that Alexandra's husband Thomas had caused. Thomas wanted to take a throat on his wife now? But then the colleagues in the forensic technology find a pistol near the crime scene. An extraordinary find, because the weapon was last shot in Hamburg years ago in a robbery. Does the unknown Rauber now also have Alexandra Preuss on his conscience? / Auf einem Acker nahe einer LandstraSSe finden Stine und Timmermann ein verunglucktes Taxi. Die Fahrerin, Alexandra Preuss, sitzt noch am Steuer - mit einer Schusswunde im Herz!Die Spuren am Tatort beweisen, dass der Tater im Auto gesessen haben muss. Doch von einem Beifahrer fehlt jede Spur. Hat Alexandras Ehemann Thomas etwas mit ihrem Tod zu tun? Erst kurzlich hatte sich Alexandra von ihm getrennt, doch er hat das nicht wahrhaben wollen.Alexandra Preuss war allerdings frisch verliebt. Der neue Mann in ihrem Leben war Feuerwehrmann Florian Sagmeister. Die beiden lernten sich bei einem Autounfall kennen, den ausgerechnet Alexandras Ehemann Thomas verursacht hatte. Wollte Thomas sich nun an seiner Frau rachen?Doch dann finden die Kollegen der Kriminaltechnik in der Nahe des Tatorts eine Pistole. Ein auSSerst brisanter Fund, denn mit der Waffe wurde zuletzt vor Jahren bei einem Raububerfall in Hamburg geschossen. Hat der unbekannte Rauber von damals nun auch Alexandra Preuss auf dem Gewissen?

Ist die Liaison aus dem Ruder gelaufen, und Walch wollte dem ein Ende setzen? Und welche Rolle spielt Anna Miras Agentin in dem Mordfall? programme.title: Agency, annoyance and freedom - where are we in the east? / Einigkeit, Verdruss und Freiheit - Wo stehen wir im Osten?
programme.desc: On October 3, 1990, two German states became Germany. Everything was different for the people from the GDR. Little for the people in the West. How are we united today? The annoyance in the country, the dissatisfaction, seem to be gaining weight - especially in the east. But what are the reason for that? How do people look today, 35 years after reunification, their home, their life and the "system" Federal Republic? Birgit Warnke's film is looking for traces and sprints in the east - for example at a pub evening in the small Thuringian village of Niederbosa. The AfD recently won more than 60 percent. Where does dissatisfaction come from in the idyllic 130-soul community? Or at the nationwide largest Simson meeting in Zwickau, which attracts many young men, who celebrate their GDR cult mopeds and their East German identity for four days. The Doku also has the history of Petra Peterhansel, which has done its training at Wartburg in the VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach and is now heading the BMW plant in Leipzig. She is one of the few East Germans that made it into a top position. Just one exception? Why are East German in the East Germans still underrapsed in the East German in Fuhrung? And what did it do with the east that the population has shrunk by 15 percent since 1990 and so many people migrated to the West? He is the front man of the punk band "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", who is committed to right -wing radicalism. "Monchi" was born in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, there would be no option to go to the West. The documentary accompanies him on his "Wasted in Jarmen" festival with which he and his band liked to look at what connects and not to what separates. For "Monchi", political differences are not necessarily east -west, but above all a question from the city and country. And then there are the former NVA officers who are still meeting regularly today and exchanged about reunification - as it has run. Also because they had imagined their lives very differently. For a long time, they no longer have everything to say - especially when it comes to their view of Russia, which is fundamentally different from the majority opinion. How do different experiences, perspectives and identities? In the film, prominent East Germans - like actress Christiane Paul, the political legend Gregor Gysi, sociologist Steffen Mau, director Christian Schwochow and journalist Valerie Schonian. / Am 3. Oktober 1990 wurde aus zwei deutschen Staaten ein Deutschland. Fur die Menschen aus der DDR anderte sich alles. Fur die Menschen im Westen nur wenig. Wie vereint sind wir heute?Der Verdruss im Land, die Unzufriedenheit, scheinen zuzunehmen - vor allem im Osten. Aber was sind dafur die Grunde? Wie blicken die Menschen heute, 35 Jahre nach der Wiedervereinigung, auf ihre Heimat, ihr Leben und das "System" Bundesrepublik?Der Film von Birgit Warnke geht auf Spurensuche und spurt den Stimmungen im Osten nach - etwa bei einem Kneipenabend in dem kleinen thuringischen Dorf Niederbosa. Dort haben mehr als 60 Prozent zuletzt die AfD gewahlt. Woher kommt die Unzufriedenheit in der idyllischen 130-Seelengemeinde? Oder bei dem bundesweit groSSten Simsontreffen in Zwickau, das vor allem viele junge Manner anzieht, die vier Tage ihre DDR-Kult-Mopeds und ihre ostdeutsche Identitat feiern.Die Doku erzahlt auch die Geschichte von Petra Peterhansel, die in der DDR im VEB Automobilwerk Eisenach ihre Ausbildung bei Wartburg gemacht hat und mittlerweile das BMW-Werk in Leipzig leitet. Sie ist eine der wenigen Ostdeutschen, die es in eine Spitzenposition geschafft hat. Nur eine Ausnahme?Warum sind 35 Jahre nach der Einheit Ostdeutsche in Fuhrung immer noch so unterreprasentiert? Und was hat es mit dem Osten gemacht, dass die Bevolkerung seit 1990 um 15 Prozent geschrumpft ist und so viele Menschen in den Westen abgewandert sind?Immer im Osten geblieben ist Jan "Monchi" Gorkow. Er ist Frontmann der Punkband "Feine Sahne Fischfilet", die sich gegen Rechtsradikalismus engagiert. "Monchi" ist in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern geboren, fur ihn ware es keine Option in den Westen zu gehen. Die Doku begleitet ihn auf sein "Wasted in Jarmen"-Festival mit dem er und seine Band auf das schauen mochten, was verbindet und nicht auf das, was trennt. Fur "Monchi" sind politische Unterschiede nicht unbedingt Ost-West Unterschiede, sondern vor allem eine Frage von Stadt und Land.Und dann sind da noch die ehemaligen NVA-Offiziere, die sich heute noch regelmaSSig treffen und uber die Wiedervereinigung - so wie sie gelaufen ist - enttauscht sind. Auch, weil sie sich ihren Lebensweg ganz anders vorgestellt hatten. Langst haben sie das Gefuhl nicht mehr alles sagen zu durfen - vor allem, wenn es um ihren Blick auf Russland geht, der sich von der Mehrheitsmeinung fundamental unterscheidet. Wie pragen unterschiedliche Erfahrungen, Sichtweisen und Identitaten?Davon erzahlen im Film auch prominente Ostdeutsche - wie die Schauspielerin Christiane Paul, die Politlegende Gregor Gysi, der Soziologe Steffen Mau, der Regisseur Christian Schwochow und die Journalistin Valerie Schonian.

programme.title: Great Nordic myths / Veliki nordijski mitovi
programme.desc: Producers of the praised documentary series Greek myths, in a new endeavor will try to extract the true meaning of Nordic stories based on the old texts available. programme.title: Pop - top / Pop - top

programme.title: Concert / Koncert
programme.desc: Enjoy with a musical program that brings us recordings of various, musical concerts. / Uživajte uz muzički program koji nam donosi snimke raznih, muzičkih koncerata.

programme.title: Record / Zapis
programme.desc: This show is a kind of postcard of Montenegro. The author and head of Miomir Maroš, ideas for the show gets from spectators who want to present their ends and interesting people living in them, but also from their own tendencies to create a kind of testimony of one time. / Ova emisija predstavlja svojevrsnu razglednicu Crne Gore. Autor i voditelj Miomir Maroš, ideje za emisiju dobija od gledalaca koji žele da predstave svoje krajeve i zanimljive ljude koji u njima žive, ali i iz sopstvenih tendencija da sa dokumentarnom notom stvori svojevrsno svjedočanstvo jednog vremena.

programme.title: Wild Beauty / Wild Beauty
programme.desc: Montenegro - wild beauty. From depths, from heights, an invaluable wealth of our country. Action, adventure, knowledge. / Crna gora - divlja ljepota. Iz dubina, sa visina, neprocjenjiva bogatstva naše zemlje. Akcija, avantura, saznanje.

programme.title: Cities / Gradovi
programme.desc: Show about the cities of Montenegro. Learn a number of interesting facts about history, tradition and culture of cities in which we live! / Emisija o gradovima Crne Gore. Saznajte brojne zanimljive činjenice o istoriji, tradiciji i kulturi gradova u kojima živimo!

programme.title: Neighbors / Komšije
programme.desc: Marital pair of artists from Belgrade, decides to move into a small place on the banks of the Danube, looking for peace and art inspiration. However, the entanglements of this comic series are just related to very alive and active everyday life of the two and their new neighbors. / Bračni par umjetnika iz Beograda, odlučuje da se preseli u malo mjesto na obali Dunava, u potrazi za mirom i umjetničkom inspiracijom. Međutim, zapleti ove komične serije upravo su vezani za veoma živu i aktivnu svakodnevnicu njih dvoje i njihovih novih komšija.

programme.title: Pepa pigs in Roma / Pepa prase na romskom jeziku
programme.desc: Pepa is a cute pig, she loves a lot to play and entertain, has a younger brother George we will hardly see without his favorite toy, green dinosaur. Enjoy adventures Pepe, George, their families and friends! / Pepa je simpatično prase, ona mnogo voli da se igra i zabavlja, ima mlađeg brata Džordža kog ćemo teško videti bez njegove omiljene igračke, zelenog dinosaurusa. Uživajte u avanturama Pepe, Džordža, njihove porodice i drugara!

programme.title: Great Nordic myths / Veliki nordijski mitovi
programme.desc: Producers of the praised documentary series Greek myths, in a new endeavor will try to extract the true meaning of Nordic stories based on the old texts available. The story that influenced some of the most popular blockbusters of today, from Tolkin's lord of the rings until George Martin's throne. / Producenti hvaljene dokumentarne serije Grčki mitovi, u novom poduhvatu pokušaće da izvuku pravo značenje nordijskih priča na osnovu dostupnih starih tekstova. Priča koje su uticale na neke od najpopularnijih blokbastera današnjice, od Tolkinovog Gospodara prstenova do Igre prijestola Džordža Martina.

programme.title: Net.Me / Mreža.me
programme.desc: We are talking about people, events, places, problems, everything you are interested in. Your stories, interesting guests. / Govorimo o ljudima, događajima, mjestima, problemima, o svemu što vas zanima. Vaše priče, interesantni gosti.

programme.title: Living room / Dnevna soba
programme.desc: It is an entertainment program show, which will try to advise and entertain the viewers. The desire is to relax and fun in an hour and a half viewers, to escape the daily problems. It is intended for all generations and family. In numerous columns, we deal with interesting and current topics, and with the help of the interlocutor we share advice for a simpler life. programme.title: Martial arts - MMA: Demacedo Vs Bivol / Borilački sport - MMA: Demacedo vs Bivol
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. He called this sport by doing this sport at the Ultimate Fighting Championship Tournament in martial arts. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. The MMA has three phases of struggles that divide legs, struggle in the kid and fight in the partner. Each struggle and round begins on their feet and then fighters most often use boxing techniques, kikboxes and Thai boxes. In the clinch, the most common boxes and Thai boxing techniques are used while the pattern is used on the partner, Juda, Sambuba and Juda Jicu. / Termin mixed martial arts se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na Ultimate Fighting Championship turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.desc: Roki Marcano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Luis. Should the more reason more to follow this noble martial skill? First traces of boxes we are already in the third century before Christ on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxes were established 18. century in London and define the combination of combat, equipment and illicit and permitted types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. programme.title: MMA hexagon 35 / MMA Hexagone 35
programme.desc: The term Mixed Martial Arts was first documented in 1993. year by the American television critics of Hauard Rozenberg. programme.title: Football - Scottish League: Livingston - Rangers / Fudbal - Škotska liga: Livingston - Rangers
programme.desc: The Scottish Football Championship in its first season has set out in 1890. years and has already been set up by one rarity. programme.title: For the Federal - Liga Evrope: Braga - Fineenoror / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Braga - Feyenoord
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB League: Zenit - CSKA, Final G1 / Košarka - VTB liga: Zenit - CSKA, finale G1
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. programme.title: Basketball - Aba Liga: Igokea - Mornar / Košarka - ABA liga: Igokea - Mornar
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. programme.title: Football: Wwin Liga BiH: Railway - Sarajevo / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Željezničar - Sarajevo
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Star with guests / Zvezdana z gosti
Hair / Lasje
programme.desc: The naive young man Claude, who strives to fulfill his parents' wishes and American war ideology, leaves the family ranch in Oklahoma and arrives in New York, where he is expected to join the soldiers on his way to Vietnam. The plans are crossed by a group of hippies, who, with a kind of lifestyle and resistance to the dominant social norms, fight against the war and the repressive culture of their parents. Clauda attaches an enlightening friendship with Berger, who introduces him into counterculture. She falls in love with Sheilo, a gentle beauty from a wealthy New York family. Hippies eventually disarm the tense Claud and give him a sense of freedom: at some point, the relaxed world of music, dance and psychedelic experiences sucks himself into himself. Group utopia is interrupted by Claudi's call to Vietnam. They are a legendary American musical that wins and disarms with experienced dance and musical points. Film hair is a powerful representative of the 1960s period who managed to capture the boiling atmosphere, the main characteristic of the then Waterman's era. staged on Broadway. The Forman film adaptation has more than successfully captured the spirit of the show. / Naivni mladenič Claude, ki si prizadeva izpolniti želje staršev in ameriške vojne ideologije, zapusti družinski ranč v Oklahomi in prispe v New York, kjer naj bi se pridružil vojakom na poti v Vietnam. Načrte mu prekriža skupina hipijev, ki se s svojevrstnim načinom življenja in upiranjem prevladujočim družbenim normam borijo proti vojni in represivni kulturi svojih staršev.Claude naveže razsvetljujoče prijateljstvo z Bergerjem, ki ga vpelje v kontrakulturo. Zaljubi v Sheilo, nežno lepotico iz premožne newyorške družine. Hipiji sčasoma razorožijo napetega Clauda in mu pričarajo občutek svobode: v nekem trenutku ga sproščeni svet glasbe, plesa in psihedeličnih doživetij posrka vase. Skupinsko utopijo pa prekine Claudov vpoklic v Vietnam.Lasje so legendaren ameriški muzikal, ki osvoji in razoroži z doživetimi plesnimi in glasbenimi točkami.Film Lasje je močan predstavnik obdobja šestdesetih, ki mu je uspelo ujeti prekipevajoče vzdušje, glavno karakteristiko tedanje vodnarjeve dobe.Začetek muzikala sega v leto 1968, ko so ga prvič uprizorili na Broadwayu. Formanova filmska priredba je več kot uspešno ujela duh predstave.

programme.title: Container wars: everything that shines / Kontejnerske vojne: Vse, kar se sveti
programme.desc: A brand new series of "container war" proves that a good balance in the bank account does not yet guarantee success in the world of port auctions, in which everything is happening at a flash pace. In this game of high inserts, to overcome opponents who also want to enrich, it also requires a good nose for mild and steel nerves. Because these are large sums of money, this is not a game, but a real war. Meet John Kunkl's auctions and auction participants who are fighting for the best bargains, including Jason R. Hughes and Matthew Gaus. Who will be out of the "container wars" as a winner? / Povsem nova serija "Kontejnerske vojne" dokazuje, da dobro stanje na bančnem računu še ne zagotavlja uspeha v svetu pristaniških dražb, v katerem se vse dogaja z bliskovitim tempom. V tej igri visokih vložkov sta za premagovanje nasprotnikov, ki si prav tako želijo obogateti, potrebna tudi dober nos za blago in jekleni živci. programme.title: Football (M): Union Berlin - HSV, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Union Berlin - HSV, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal.

programme.title: Hockey (M): Olimpija - Fehervar, Ice Hockey League 2025/2026 / Hokej (M): Olimpija - Fehervar, ICE Hockey League 2025/2026
programme.desc: The League under different names has existed since its founding in 1923, with a break during World War II. Until 2005, only Austrian teams were playing, and then Slovenian, Croatia, the Czech Republic, Italian, Hungary and Slovakia joined over the years. There are 14 teams in the league, and Slovenian colors are represented by HK Olimpija Ljubljana. / Liga pod različnimi imeni obstaja od svoje ustanovitve leta 1923, s prekinitvijo v času druge svetovne vojne. V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

V njej so do leta 2005 nastopala samo avstrijska moštva, nato pa so se skozi leta pridružila še slovenska, hrvaška, češka, italijanska, madžarska in slovaška. V ligi nastopa 14 ekip, slovenske barve pa zastopa HK Olimpija Ljubljana.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Maribor, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian first league was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent state with the collapse of the former Yugoslavia. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Nogomet (M): B. Munchen - Werder B., Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): B. Munchen - Werder B., Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: With all that Germany has given us throughout history, the Bundesliga proudly stands. In the highest rank of a football competition founded in 1963, 18 teams compete, starting matches for a popular plate every year in August. It was most often won by Bayern Munich, as many as 24 times. The cheerleading culture, full of tribes and top football is what Bundesliga adorns from its beginnings to the present day. Don't miss the opportunity to enjoy the Bundesliga matches. You will definitely not be sorry. / Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. programme.desc: A collection of objects and masterpieces dedicated to Ludwig van Beethoven, carefully kept by the Carrino family from Milj near Trieste at his home - the museum, does not leave the visitor indifferent. As well as the enchantment of collectors against an exceptional artist and his echo in the world of creation. Inactive members of societies know the importance of community societies. Among all German federal countries, Bavaria has the largest number of societies. But what to do when more and more pubs are closing, and many societies are left without premises for their meetings? In Aidenbach in the Passau district, they found a way to keep their societies alive. During the cross -border European capital of Culture 2025 in Nova Gorica and Gorizia, you can attend a fun jump into the past - the experience of everyday smuggling of a wide variety of goods across the border between Italian Gorizia and Nova Gorica or Slovenia in the 1970s. It was named Tura Tura. Perporate Anna Bozsik, a pilot in the Szolnok Helicopter Base, is the first Hungarian to participate in a foreign mission as a helicopter commander. Her first flight and night training was an unforgettable experience for her. During the mission in Bosnia and Herzegovina, she also faced the challenge of flying in a mountainous environment and proved her professional competence. / Zbirka predmetov in mojstrovin, posvečenih Ludwigu van Beethovnu, ki jo družina Carrino iz Milj pri Trstu skrbno hrani na svojem domu – muzeju, obiskovalca ne pusti ravnodušnega. Kakor tudi ne očaranost zbirateljev nad izjemnim umetnikom in njegovim odmevom v svetu ustvarjanja.Aktivni člani društev vedo, kako pomembna so društva za življenje skupnosti. Med vsemi nemškimi zveznimi deželami ima Bavarska največ društev. A kaj storiti, ko se zapira vedno več gostiln, številna društva pa tako ostanejo brez prostorov za svoja srečanja? V Aidenbachu v okrožju Passau, so našli način, kako svoja društva ohraniti pri življenju. V času čezmejne evropske prestolnice kulture 2025 v Novi Gorici in Gorici se lahko udeležite zabavnega skoka v preteklost – izkušnje vsakdanjega tihotapljenja najrazličnejšega blaga čez mejo med italijansko Gorizio in Novo Gorico oziroma Slovenijo v sedemdesetih letih preteklega stoletja. Poimenovali so jo Šverc tura.Poročnica Anna Bozsik, pilotka v helikopterski bazi Szolnok, je prva Madžarka, ki je sodelovala v tuji misiji kot poveljnica helikopterja. Njen prvi polet in nočni trening sta bila zanjo nepozabna izkušnja. Med misijo v Bosni in Hercegovini se je spopadla tudi z izzivom letenja v goratem okolju in dokazala svojo strokovno usposobljenost.

programme.desc: The apartment in a new building combines the charm of Scandinavian minimalism and Japanese calm. Join us in an exclusive view of this design pearl, where wooden elements create a sense of warmth and harmony. In the heart of the village of Podpeč under the Karst edge, a wonderful story of two dedicated owners, who, with their zeal and love for cultural heritage, re -inhaled their lives in the antique Slovenian homestead. We have already introduced their garden, which is painted by roses, and this time we will focus on the houses that have been renovated and created their new home in one of them. The story leads us through personal and architectural surpluses, which have arisen from their decision to return from Urban Trieste to a picturesque rural environment. / Stanovanje v novogradnji združuje šarm skandinavskega minimalizma in japonsko umirjenost. Predstavili smo že njun vrt, ki ga barvajo vrtnice, tokrat pa se bomo posvetili hiškama, ki sta ju obnovila in v eni od njiju ustvarila svoj novi dom. Zgodba nas vodi skozi osebne in arhitekturne presežke, ki so vzniknili iz njune odločitve, da se vrneta iz urbanega Trsta v slikovito ruralno okolje.

programme.desc: Part 4.: Schonbrunn - The brilliance and fall of the Habsburg -bright part reveals the stunning history of one of the most famous ruling homes of all time, the Schonbrunn mansion, the symbol of the Austrian imperial legacy and one of the oldest European rulers, the Habsburgs. The simple hunting mansion, which was built at the end of the 17th century by Leopold I., was transformed into a luxurious imperial court by Mary Theresa, and last shone during the reign of Franz Joseph, just before World War I. This cultural and architectural pearl of the past is still admiring the whole world today. The Wonders of Europe II. / Leurope des Mervilles II. / France / 2024 / Director: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte. / 4. del: Schonbrunn – blišč in padec HabsburžanovČetrti del razkriva osupljivo zgodovino enega najznamenitejših vladarskih domovanj vseh časov, dunajskega dvorca Schonbrunn, simbola avstrijske imperialne zapuščine in ene najstarejših evropskih vladarskih rodbin, Habsburžanov. Preprosti lovski dvorec, ki ga je dal ob koncu 17. stoletja zgraditi Leopold I., je Marija Terezija spremenila v razkošen cesarski dvor, zadnjič pa je zablestel v času vladanja Franca Jožefa, tik pred prvo svetovno vojno. Ta kulturni in arhitekturni biser minule dobe še danes občuduje ves svet. THE WONDERS OF EUROPE II. / LEUROPE DES MERVEILLES II. / Francija / 2024 / Režija: Anne-Sophie Chaumier Le Conte.

programme.title: Holy Višarje: the intersection of three nations in the Julian Alps, a documentary, Mon. / Svete Višarje: Stičišče treh narodov v Julijskih Alpah, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.desc: The history of the Highlands is a story of a meeting of three great civilizations that built Europe: Latin, Germanic and Slavic. It is a place of great spirituality that has passed the test of time, although tourism and modern hiking, which developed at the sanctuary, have greatly changed the way and purposes of visiting this wonderful point overlooking the Julian Alps. Due to their holiness and history, the highlands are a place without borders, a meeting point of different nations and languages ​​that coexist here and harmony. The documentary recounts the history and development of the shrine and hamlet in Višarje through the testimonies of the historian, priest and locals. The duality of the holy and secular further enhances the charm of this place, related to the tradition, which is one of the most popular shrines and excursion points around. / Zgodovina Višarij je zgodba o srečanju treh velikih civilizacij, ki so gradile Evropo: latinske, germanske in slovanske. To je kraj velike duhovnosti, ki je prestal preizkus časa, čeprav sta turizem in sodoben način pohodništva, ki se je razvil ob svetišču, močno spremenila način in namene obiska te čudovite točke s pogledom na Julijske Alpe. Zaradi svoje svetosti in zgodovine pa so Višarje kraj brez meja, stičišče različnih narodov in jezikov, ki tu sobivajo v miru in sozvočju. Dokumentarni film pripoveduje o zgodovini in razvoju svetišča in zaselka na Višarjah skozi pričevanja zgodovinarja, duhovnika in domačinov. Dvojnost svetega in posvetnega še krepi čar tega kraja, vezanega na tradicijo, ki ga izjemna slikovitost okolja uvršča med najbolj priljubljena svetišča in izletniške točke daleč naokrog.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

Stasi Cast: con Claudio Bisio, Sarah Felberbaum, Pietro Sermonti, Paolo Calabresi, Guglielmo Poggi Paese - Anno: IT - 2019Dopo essere stato Presidente della Repubblica per caso e con un alto gradimento, il pescatore Giuseppe "Peppino" Garibaldi si è ritirato a vivere in montagna con la moglie Janis e la figlia Guevara. Otto anni più tardi Janis è stanca della vita isolata e decide di lasciare Peppino per tornare a Roma, al Quirinale, chiamata ad affiancare il presidente in una difficile transizione di governo. Pur di riconquistare la moglie e stare vicino a Guevara, Peppino decide di trasferirsi a Roma e accetta lelezione a Presidente del Consiglio in un periodo politico ricco di intrighi e sotterfugi.

programme.desc: In our eyes, animals can often have strange or funny behaviors, or find themselves in fun situations. Il viaggio attorno al mondo proposto da questo documentario offre una carrellata di momenti spiritosi colmi di spassose e coinvolgenti buffonerie e acrobazie, in compagnia di animali selvaggi di ogni tipo. Dai macachi giapponesi ai pinguini africani, dai granchi rossi dellIsola di Natale ai lupi artici, diventiamo spettatori del circo della natura selvaggia, tra lotte, giochi, rituali di corteggiamento e momenti di relax.

programme.title: Io and Marilyn / Io and Marilyn
programme.desc: Gualtiero is involved by friends in a spirit session that evokes the spirit of Marylin Monroe. And here Gualtiero finds himself at home Licona world of sensuality and femininity. But there is a problem: only he manages to see her and speak to her. Luckily Arnolfo, already an expert in the spirits sector and roars, helps him not to feel crazy, confiding on him, for example, having had at home for 40 days nothing less than Hitler. Marilyn thus becomes Gualtiero's personal consultant and helps him to solve love trouble and personal tragedies. In fact, Luomo has an ex -wife, Ramona, who left him to go to live in a circus with Pasquale, a Neapolitan tamer. Ramona brought his daughter he had from Gualtiero to live in the circus: Martina. Aided by her new friend Marilyn, Gualtiero sought in every way to recover her family. / Gualtiero viene coinvolto dagli amici in una una seduta spiritica che evoca lo spirito di Marylin Monroe. Ed ecco che Gualtiero si ritrova a casa licona mondiale della sensualita e della femminilita. Ma ce un problema: solo lui riesce a vederla e a parlarle. Meno male che Arnolfo, gia esperto nel settore spiriti e aldila, lo aiutera a non sentirsi pazzo, confidandogli ad esempio di aver avuto in casa per 40 giorni niente meno che Hitler. Marilyn diventa cosi la consulente personale di Gualtiero e lo aiutera a risolvere guai amorosi e tragedie personali. Luomo ha infatti una ex moglie, Ramona, che lo ha lasciato per andare a vivere in un circo con Pasquale, un domatore napoletano. Ramona ha portato con se a vivere nel circo anche la figlia avuta da Gualtiero: Martina. Aiutato dalla sua nuova amica Marilyn, Gualtiero cerchera in tutti i modi di riprendersi la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Modem / Modem
programme.desc: In these days, Denmark has mainly been expected, with several airports affected within 48 hours by the presence of mysterious drones that caused the temporary closure of the airports and alarm the authorities of the Scandinavian country, a member of the Atlantic alliance. For defense minister Troels Lund Poulsen these attacks can make danger of security and freedom. At the moment the origin of these drones still remains to be clarified, the Danish authorities do not exclude that it can be Russian aircraft. NATO has also entered alarm, already compared in recent weeks with various incursions of drones and Russian hunting in the skies of Poland, Norway, Romania and Estonia. What are it and how much these continuous actions of disorder really represent a danger to the safety of the entire eastern front of the European Union? What does all this mean for NATO? And how much do these incursions tell us about the current military strength of Russia? Topics and questions that we discuss with: - Orietta Moscatelli, geo -political analyst and expert from Russia - Beda Romano, European correspondent of the Sole 24 Ore - Alessandro Colombo, professor of international relations at the Milan state road this at a time when the US president seems to want to openly support Ukrainian. After a meeting with Zelensky, on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York, Trump said that "Ukraine could regain all its territory and go further" and this because Russia is now only "a paper tiger". / In questi giorni a farne le spese è stata soprattutto la Danimarca, con diversi aeroporti colpiti nel giro di 48 ore dalla presenza di misteriosi droni che hanno provocato la chiusura temporanea degli scali e messo in allarme le autorità del Paese scandinavo, membro dell’Alleanza atlantica. Per il ministro della difesa Troels Lund Poulsen questi attacchi possono mettere il pericolo la sicurezza e la libertà. Al momento rimane ancora da chiarire l’origine di questi droni, le autorità danesi non escludono che si possa trattare di velivoli russi. In allarme è entrata anche la Nato, già confrontata nelle scorse settimane con diverse incursioni di droni e di caccia russi nei cieli di Polonia, Norvegia, Romania e Estonia. Di cosa si tratta e quanto queste continue azioni di disturbo rappresentano davvero un pericolo per la sicurezza di tutto il fronte orientale dell’Unione europea? Cosa vuol dire tutto ciò per la Nato? E quanto queste incursioni ci dicono dell’attuale forza militare della Russia? Argomenti e interrogativi che discutiamo con:- Orietta Moscatelli, analista geo-politica e esperta di Russia - Beda Romano, corrispondente europeo del Sole 24 ore - Alessandro Colombo, professore di relazioni internazionali alla Statale di MilanoE questo in un momento in cui il presidente statunitense sembra voler sostenere apertamente l’Ucraina. Dopo un incontro con Zelensky, a margine dell’Assemblea generale dell’ONU a New York, Trump ha affermato che “l’Ucraina potrebbe riconquistare tutto il suo territorio e andare anche oltre” e questo perche la Russia è ormai soltanto “una tigre di carta”.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: The lady in yellow (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American yellow show, with the participation of Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. He aired weekly on the CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV-Movie, until 2003 (as a wagon read with murder, the ballad of the lost boy and appointment with death). Angela Lansbury played the role of executive producer of the show in his last seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspective writer of yellow, who often finds himself dealing with mysterious murders, for whom he always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small village, the fictitious Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of La Signora in Yellow is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the first choice of the manufacturer. The part had been initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however refused. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni. Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: The Giacometti / I Giacometti
programme.desc: Laspra Val Bregaglia gave birth to a dynasty of artists: the Giacometti. Alberto has revolutionized the world of art with his slender figures, his brother Diego was a valid sculptor and designer previously, John their father, friend of Cuno Amiet and Ferdinand Hodler, was one of the first Swiss painters to integrate modern trends in his art. What has made this valley, the birthplace of many artists? The director Susanna Fanzun puts herself on the trail of this extraordinary family. / Laspra Val Bregaglia ha dato i natali a una dinastia di artisti: i Giacometti. Alberto ha rivoluzionato il mondo dellarte con le sue figure slanciate, il fratello Diego è stato un valido scultore e designer In precedenza, Giovanni il loro padre, amico di Cuno Amiet e Ferdinand Hodler, è stato uno dei primi pittori svizzeri a integrare le tendenze moderne nella sua arte. Che cosa ha reso questa valle, il luogo di nascita di tanti artisti? La regista Susanna Fanzun si mette sulle tracce di questa famiglia straordinaria.

programme.title: Signs of the times / Segni dei tempi
programme.desc: We enter the world of photography through the eyes of a man who in Malcantone had a bridge between German Switzerland and Ticino, between Protestantism and the Catholic world. An opportunity to rediscover the work of Eugenio Schmidhauser who innovated the imagination of Ticino in the early twentieth century. A photographic production his capable of moving in a cultural environment in which borders came to fall. Between the Appenzello and Bavaria, between Ticino and Europe, between reality and caricature. / Entriamo nel mondo della fotografia attraverso gli occhi di un uomo che nel Malcantone fece da ponte fra Svizzera tedesca e Ticino, fra protestantesimo e mondo cattolico. Un’occasione per riscoprire il lavoro di Eugenio Schmidhauser che innovò l’immaginario del Ticino di inizio Novecento. Una produzione fotografica la sua capace di muoversi in un ambiente culturale in cui venivano a cadere le frontiere. Tra l’Appenzello e la Baviera, tra il Ticino e l’Europa, tra la realtà e la caricatura.

programme.title: Paganini / Paganini
programme.desc: Just in these days, sixty years ago, one of the fundamental pages of international pop rock was written: on May 12, 1965 at the RCA Studios of Hollywood I Rolling Stones recorded the single (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction which would be published in the United States on June 6, 1965, quickly leaping at the head of the Billboard Hot 100. Keith Richards who in one one cleared cleared up to the top of the rankings the most acidic distortions and proclaimed the British Invasion as a cultural and social phenomenon of global scope. Paganini has chosen to dedicate the episode of Sunday 18 May to this anniversary - from 10.30 on RSI LA1 - however, facing it indirectly: first of all commissioning the Balkan Lovers group a new version of (I Cant Get No) Satiscation, transposing it from the era and gender to affirm its symbolic and transversal cultural value. The second reference to the Stones is given by the documentary Catching Fire, the story of Alexis Bloom and Svetlana Zill's Anita Playergg. Model, actress and icon of style, Anita Palenberg was linked to the Rolling Stones both by the heart issues (girlfriend first of Brian Jones and then Keith Richards, from whom she had three children) both from artistic aspects, acting as a real muse and inspiring for the group's lestetic. The film is based on the autobiography of the Palenberg - entitled Black Magic - which remained unpublished and found by the children after his death in 2017. For this reason, the intimate and posthumous reading of the pages of the diary was entrusted to the voice of Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, the story of Anita Playlenberg - (I Cant Get no) Satiscation / Proprio in questi giorni, sessantanni fa, si scriveva una delle pagine fondamentali del pop rock internazionale: il 12 maggio 1965 agli RCA Studios di Hollywood i Rolling Stones registravano infatti il singolo (I cant get no) Satisfaction che sarebbe stato pubblicato negli Stati Uniti il 6 giugno 1965, balzando rapidamente in testa alla Billboard Hot 100. Si trattò del primo grande successo del gruppo di Mick Jagger e Keith Richards che in un sol colpo sdoganava in cima alle classifiche le distorsioni più acide e proclamava la British invasion come un fenomeno culturale e sociale di portata globale. Paganini ha scelto di dedicare a questo anniversario la puntata di domenica 18 maggio - dalle 10.30 su RSI LA1 - affrontandolo però indirettamente: innanzitutto commissionando al gruppo Balkan Lovers una nuova versione di (I cant get no) Satisfaction, trasponendola di epoca e di genere per affermarne il valore culturale simbolico e trasversale. Il secondo riferimento agli Stones è dato dal documentario Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg di Alexis Bloom e Svetlana Zill. Modella, attrice e icona di stile, Anita Pallenberg fu legata ai Rolling Stones sia da questioni di cuore (fidanzata prima di Brian Jones e poi di Keith Richards, da cui ebbe tre figli) sia da aspetti artistici, fungendo da vera e propria musa e ispiratrice per lestetica del gruppo. Il film è basato sullautobiografia della Pallenberg - intitolata Black Magic - rimasta inedita e ritrovata dai figli dopo la sua morte nel 2017. Per questo, la lettura intima e postuma delle pagine del diario è stata affidata alla voce di Scarlett Johansson. - Catching Fire, la storia di Anita Pallenberg - (I Cant Get No) Satisfaction

programme.sub-title: Medicaments à l’unite : economie ou illusion ?
programme.desc: The costs of the health explode in Switzerland, our insurance premiums too. Each year, more than 600 million francs in drugs leave in the trash. Pour changer la donne, certains pharmaciens testent la distribution des pilules à l’unite. Est-ce une vraie solution pour reduire les coûts de la sante ou de la poudre aux yeux ? « A bon entendeur » fait le point, mardi soir, dès 20h10, sur RTS1.

programme.sub-title: Le bruit de la vie quotidienne par Nikesco
programme.desc: Nikesco, aka Nicolas Combes, is a French comic book author well known to deaf people. The Signs emission has made his portrait, between Paris where he resides and the city of Rolle for a dedication session to meet the Swiss public. / Nikesco, alias Nicolas Combes, est un auteur de BD français bien connu des personnes sourdes. Depuis 2020, il a publie deux romans graphiques, Le Bruit des Gens tome 1 et 2, dans lesquels il met en scène son propre quotidien de sourd dans un monde d’entendants bruyants. Resultat : une foule d’histoires drôles, decalee, au ton parfois un peu moqueur mais toujours tendre. L’emission Signes a realise son portrait, entre Paris où il reside et la ville de Rolle pour une seance de dedicace à la rencontre du public suisse.

programme.title: The Swiss Miracle / Le Miracle Suisse
programme.desc: Since the beginning of its history, Swiss television gives the floor to teens, on all the subjects that touch them: parents, school, future, love. We even have an emission in which their first cigarette is smoked, which would obviously be unimaginable today! We have found, 30 years later, a young boy who was testing the difficulty of being young in 1994. We will also look at the little fictional scenes on adolescents, the emission of Debat Agora in the 80s, and we will review all adolescent looks through the years, from BCBG to punks, passing by Bennets, Skaters, "Emos" "Roots". Thanks to the Swiss miracle we are still 15 years old! / Depuis le debut de son histoire, la television suisse donne la parole aux ados, sur tous les sujet qui les touchent : parents, ecole, avenir, amour. Nous avons meme une emission dans laquelle on leur fait fumer leur première cigarette, ce qui serait evidemment inimaginable aujourd’hui ! Nous avons retrouve, 30 ans après, un jeune garçon qui temoignait de la difficulte d’etre jeune en 1994. Nous regarderons aussi les petites scènes de fiction sur les adolescents, de l’emission de debat Agora dans les annees 80, et nous passerons en revue tous les looks adolescents à travers les annees, des BCBG aux punks, en passant par les Bennets, les skaters, les « emos », et les « roots ». Grâce au Miracle Suisse on a toujours 15 ans !

programme.title: Ramdam / Ramdam
programme.desc: A few weeks before the inauguration of the fantastic tower in Neuchâtel, an old prison transformed into a cultural space dedicated to the fantastic worlds, Ramdam is going to meet artists who imagine characters, landscapes and sounds of the fantastic genre. Among them, John Howe, artistic director of the Lord of the Rings trilogy, granted us a big interview. But ultimately, why do we need so much to tell fantastic stories? / A quelques semaines de l’inauguration de La Tour du Fantastique à Neuchâtel, ancienne prison transformee en espace culturel dedie aux mondes fantastiques, RAMDAM est alle rencontrer des artistes qui imaginent des personnages, des paysages et des sons tires du genre fantastique. Parmi eux, John Howe, directeur artistique de la trilogie du Seigneur des anneaux, nous a accorde une grande interview. Mais finalement, pourquoi a-t-on tant besoin de se raconter des histoires fantastiques ?

programme.desc: The superstar dhollywood, Bruce Willis, makes an impressive performance in this thrilling Thriller of Lecrivain-Ralister M. Night Shyamalan (nomine with the Oscars in the Categories of Best Original and Best Realizing Scenario) that criticisms qualify as moon of the best stories of ghosts ever filmed. Films with an intensity to give goosebumps, the discovery of Lincoyable Sixth Sense of Cole leads them in mysterious places with unforgettable consequences! / La superstar dHollywood, Bruce Willis, fait une impressionnante performance dans ce palpitant thriller de lecrivain-realisateur M. Night Shyamalan (nomine aux Oscars dans les categories de meilleur scenario original et de meilleur realisateur) que les critiques qualifient comme lune des meilleures histoires de fantômes jamais filmees. Quand le Dr Malcolm Crowe (Willis), un eminent psychologue pour enfants, rencontre Cole Sear (Haley Joel Osment, l’acteur nomine aux Oscars dans la categorie de meilleur acteur dans un second rôle), un enfant de huit ans effraye et confus, il n’est pas prepare à faire face à la verite de ce qui hante Cole. Filme avec une intensite à donner la chair de poule, la decouverte de lincroyable sixième sens de Cole les conduit dans des lieux mysterieux aux consequences inoubliables!

programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The first trip goes to the Emmental to Brigitte Wegmuller and her family. Together with her husband Hansjurg, she runs a small company as a fourth generation for the sideline. Hansjurg works 100 percent as a insemination technician, Brigitte heads the play group in the village twice a week. Together Brigitte and Hansjurg have the two boys Andrin and Beni. Beni needs a little more care in the family, he has autistic spectrum disorder. “Chrach U Hoger” are typical in the Emmental, steep mats alternate with gentle huldowners. "We have a slope, no property," she says, because her farmhouse looks as if it were glued on the slope. Together with father -in -law Hans and the two boys, they want to play for the rural women as the “family band Wegmuller” for the Apero. With her competitors, she wants to score from the farm with many own products. Although Brigitte loves traditional things, she has decided against the fact that Emmental dishes are made. Whether your competitors expect traditional Bernese dishes? programme.title: Puls / Puls
programme.desc: In the event of severe heart problems, herbials are important. In the new SRF "crime scene" "chamber fibrillation" they are converted into a murder weapon by hackers. How much reality is in the thriller, what questions about cyber security does it raise? And what does the scenario do in people with a heart implant? Living with heart implant-fear of hackers? «Puls» host Daniela warehouse hits a 43-year-old man who has lived with a defibrillator implant with a pacemaker since his youth. The device has already saved his life. How does the "crime scene" story get to him? The crime thriller evokes additional fears? Manipulated implants - what is possible, what is likely? Herzimplants are controlled by software that can occasionally practice an update. Opens the Boswilt Hackern Tur and Gate? In any case, sensitive simulations in the past have already shown that hacks of insulin pumps, pacemakers and defibrillator implants are possible. A specialist for IT security analyzes the "crime scene" scenarios-and "pulse" asks: give the medical attributors to the IT risks. Enjoyment of attention? Target healthcare-how to deal with the cyber risk? Sensitive data and vital infrastructure are lucrative goals for blackmail. The healthcare system is therefore becoming increasingly exposed to more often more often cyber attacks that aim for data theft or blockages. “Pulse” shows how Swiss Spitalers deal with increasing networking. Confidence in the implant - is it needed to clear up over cyber risks? «Pulse» accompanies Markus Schwab at the annual check of his autumn in the Bernese island hospital. How important is cyber security for the cardiologist? Are the possible risks for his patients an issue at all, or was it only unnecessarily burdening the basic trust into the vital implant? “Puls” chat-questions and answers about the subject of her ceremony You Questions about cardiac arrhythmic disorders and her implants? Would you like to know more about health aspects or the cyber security of the rises? Don't let the “crime scene” scenario rest? A seven -headed specialist round of cardiologists and cyber specialists knows on Monday from 9:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. Rat - live in chat. Questions can be submitted from Sunday evening. / Bei schweren Herzproblemen sind Herzimplantate uberlebenswichtig. Im neuen SRF-«Tatort» «Kammerflimmern» werden sie von Hackern zur Mordwaffe umfunktioniert. Wie viel Realitat steckt im Krimi, welche Fragen zur Cybersicherheit wirft er auf? Und was lost das Szenario bei Menschen mit einem Herzimplantat aus?Leben mit Herz-Implantat – Angst vor Hackern?«Puls»-Host Daniela Lager trifft einen 43-jahrigen Familienvater, der seit seiner Jugend mit einem Defibrillator-Implantat samt Herzschrittmacher lebt. Das Gerat hat ihm schon das Leben gerettet. Wie kommt die «Tatort»-Story bei ihm an? Weckt der Krimi zusatzliche Ängste?Manipulierte Implantate – Was ist moglich, was wahrscheinlich?Herzimplantate werden von Software gesteuert, die gelegentlich ein Update benotigen konnen. Öffnet das boswilligen Hackern Tur und Tor? Dass Hacks von Insulinpumpen, Herzschrittmachern und Defibrillator-Implantaten moglich sind, haben aufsehenerregende Simulationen in der Vergangenheit jedenfalls schon gezeigt. Ein Spezialist fur IT-Sicherheit analysiert die «Tatort»-Szenarien – und «Puls» fragt: Schenken die Medizingeratehersteller den IT-Risiken genugend Aufmerksamkeit?Zielscheibe Gesundheitswesen – Wie umgehen mit der Cybergefahr?Sensible Daten und lebenswichtige Infrastruktur sind lukrative Ziele fur Erpresser. Das Gesundheitswesen sieht sich deshalb immer haufigeren Cyberattacken ausgesetzt, die Datendiebstahl oder Blockaden zum Ziel haben. «Puls» zeigt, wie Schweizer Spitaler damit bei zunehmender Vernetzung umgehen.Vertrauen ins Implantat – Braucht es Aufklarung uber Cyberrisiken?«Puls» begleitet Markus Schwab beim jahrlichen Check seines Herzimplantats im Berner Inselspital. Welchen Stellenwert hat dabei die Cybersicherheit fur den Kardiologen? Sind die moglichen Risiken fur seine Patientinnen und Patienten uberhaupt ein Thema, oder wurde eine Aufklarung nur unnotig das Grundvertrauen ins lebenswichtige Implantat belasten? «Puls»-Chat – Fragen und Antworten zum Thema HerzimplantateHaben Sie Fragen zu Herzrhythmus-Storungen und Herzimplantaten? Mochten Sie mehr zu gesundheitlichen Aspekten oder zur Cybersicherheit der Gerate wissen? Lasst Ihnen das «Tatort»-Szenario keine Ruhe? Eine siebenkopfige Fachrunde von Kardiologen und Cyberspezialisten weiss am Montag von 21.00 bis 23.00 Uhr Rat – live im Chat. Fragen konnen bereits ab Sonntagabend eingereicht werden.

When the war comes to an end, Robert Oppenheimer, as a consultant of the American atomic energy hordes, which was co-founded by Lewis Strauss, is committed to international control of nuclear energy and against nuclear race-and is targeted by the FBI. / Als dem Physiker Julius Robert Oppenheimer wahrend des Zweiten Weltkriegs die wissenschaftliche Leitung des Manhattan-Projekts ubertragen wird, konnen er uns seine Ehefrau Kitty sich nicht vorstellen, welche Auswirkungen Oppenheimers Arbeit nicht nur auf ihr Leben, sondern auf die ganze Welt haben wird. Im Los Alamos National Laboratory in New Mexico sollen er und sein Team unter der Aufsicht von Lt. Leslie Groves eine Nuklearwaffe entwickeln – was ihnen auch gelingt. Oppenheimer wird zum „Vater der Atombombe“ ausgerufen, doch dass seine todliche Erfindung bald folgenschwer in Hiroshima und Nagasaki eingesetzt wird, lasst Oppenheimer Abstand von dem Projekt nehmen. programme.desc: The 24-year Jasmina Berchill takes Ritalin in the morning before going to work. «The medication helps me that I have the mind under control and not the mud. But I'm still a must. » So that she can sleep in after, she needs a strong sleeping pills. Narcolepsy is a neurological sleep-wake disaster in which the natural regulation of sleep and alertness is wherever. Jasmina can only master her job as a management assistant in a 50 percent workload and with breaks in which she can sleep. Celia Graf fell asleep in the most inappropriate situations. For example, during a conversation with your partner. In addition to the sleeping attacks, Celia Graf also suffers from catablexia, a muscle slack that occurs in strong emotions. For example, if she has to laugh strongly, it may be that it loses control over certain body parts. Celia takes part in a new medication study. That gives her hope for more quality of life. programme.title: SRF bi de Lut / SRF bi de Lut
programme.desc: The first trip goes to the Emmental to Brigitte Wegmuller and her family. Together with her husband Hansjurg, she runs a small company as a fourth generation for the sideline. Hansjurg works 100 percent as a insemination technician, Brigitte heads the play group in the village twice a week. Together Brigitte and Hansjurg have the two boys Andrin and Beni. Beni needs a little more care in the family, he has autistic spectrum disorder. “Chrach U Hoger” are typical in the Emmental, steep mats alternate with gentle huldowners. "We have a slope, no property," she says, because her farmhouse looks as if it were glued on the slope. Eleven mother cows, some goats, chicken, rabbits, cats and court dog Gina are also cared for by Brigitte. Brigitte plays Bassgeige, Hansjurg Schwyzerorgeli. Together with father -in -law Hans and the two boys, they want to play for the rural women as the “family band Wegmuller” for the Apero. With her competitors, she wants to score from the farm with many own products. Although Brigitte loves traditional things, she has decided against the fact that Emmental dishes are made. Whether your competitors expect traditional Bernese dishes? The other episodes “SRF BI DE LUT - Landfrauenkuche” 2017 at an overview: Friday, October 6th: Irene Schmid from Fluhli Lufreit, October 13th: Marlise Baur from Travers Nefreag, 20. October: Monika Knellwolf from Waldstatt AR Friday, October 27th: Karin Hengartner from Olten November: November 1st: Nicole Tanner from Maienfeld Grffreitag, November 10th: Manuela Barmettler from Emmetten Nov day, November 11: Finale (Live) / Die erste Reise fuhrt die Landfrauen ins Emmental zu Brigitte Wegmuller und ihrer Familie. Gemeinsam mit ihrem Mann Hansjurg fuhrt sie einen kleinen Betrieb als Nebenerwerbshof in vierter Generation. Hansjurg arbeitet zu 100 Prozent als Besamungstechniker, Brigitte leitet zweimal die Woche die Spielgruppe im Dorf. Zusammen haben Brigitte und Hansjurg die beiden Buben Andrin und Beni. Beni braucht in der Familie etwas mehr Betreuung, er hat eine autistische Spektrumsstorung. «Chrache u Hoger» sind typisch im Emmental, steile Matten wechseln sich ab mit sanften Hugelkuppen. «Wir haben eine Hangeschaft, keine Liegenschaft», erzahlt sie, denn ihr Bauernhaus wirkt, als ob es am Hang angeklebt ware. Elf Mutterkuhe, einige Ziegen, Huhner, Kaninchen, Katzen und Hofhund Gina werden ebenfalls von Brigitte umsorgt. Brigitte spielt Bassgeige, Hansjurg Schwyzerorgeli. Zusammen mit Schwiegervater Hans und den beiden Buben wollen sie fur die Landfrauen als «Familienkapelle Wegmuller» zum Apero aufspielen. Bei ihren Konkurrentinnen will sie kulinarisch mit moglichst vielen eigenen Produkten vom Hof punkten. Obwohl Brigitte Traditionelles liebt, hat sie sich gegen wahrschafte Emmentaler Gerichte entschieden. Ob ihre Konkurrentinnen traditionelle Berner Gerichte erwarten?Die weiteren Folgen «SRF bi de Lut - Landfrauenkuche» 2017 im Überblick: Freitag, 6. Oktober: Irene Schmid aus Fluhli LUFreitag, 13. Rumane Razvan, meanwhile, is suffering from Amanda that it was his childhood dream to move to the United States - and the alarm bells are immediately with the American. / Tyray ist nach Denver gereist, um dort die „echte Carmella“ zu treffen. Vier Jahre lang war er einem Trugbild aufgesessen und in eine Frau verliebt, hinter der sich jemand ganz anderes verbarg. Als er seine vermeintliche Traumpartnerin zum ersten Mal live sieht, haut es den 33-Jahrigen fast um: Sie sieht noch besser aus als auf den Fotos der Dating-App und ist ausgesprochen freundlich. Steckt sie wirklich mit dem Betruger Christian unter einer Decke? Rumane Razvan eroffnet Amanda derweil, dass es sein Kindheitstraum sei, in die USA zu ziehen – und bei der Amerikanerin lauten sofort die Alarmglocken.

programme.title: Dating without limits - emigration for love / Dating ohne Grenzen - Auswandern fur die Liebe
programme.desc: Ariela's ex-man Leandro comes to Ethiopia, but Biniyam is not enthusiastic about the visit, especially since his wife is working on the masses: Ari welcomes her ex into high-heels and chic dress, and she also lets herself get her nail. When she also forgets to put her engagement ring on her finger, the Ethiopian becomes suspicious. The Wedding planner has now been ordered in Ecuador. Evelin wants a real dream wedding to envy all of her friends. Gatte Corey is supposed to pay everything and becomes pale when he sees the horrendous prices, from $ 25,000. / Arielas Ex-Mann Leandro kommt nach Äthiopien, doch Biniyam ist uber den Besuch gar nicht begeistert, zumal sich seine Frau uber die MaSSen ins Zeug legt: Ari empfangt ihren Ex in High-Heels und schickem Kleid, auSSerdem lasst sie sich extra die Nagel machen. Als sie dann auch noch vergisst, ihren Verlobungsring an den Finger zu stecken, wird der Äthiopier misstrauisch. In Ecuador Ist inzwischen die Wedding-Planerin bestellt. Evelin will eine echte Traumhochzeit, um die sie all ihre Freundinnen beneiden. Gatte Corey soll alles zahlen und wird blass, als er die horrenden Preise, ab 25.000 Dollar aufwarts, sieht.
